shortBulletSummary: Crypto market sentiment is fearful. The Crypto Fear & Greed Index sits at 36, indicating fear, with Bitcoin below $60k and Ethereum under $1.7k, reflecting sustained selling pressure.

US tariff threats loom. New US tariff threats against China and other nations could dampen global trade and economic growth, increasing inflation concerns and negatively impacting risk assets like crypto.

Fed rate hike expected. The market strongly anticipates a 25 basis point interest rate hike from the Federal Reserve in December, which typically strengthens the USD and leads to a rotation out of riskier assets.
SBI Solana Global launches. Japan's SBI and Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group have launched a Solana-based financial venture, integrating $2.3 trillion in assets into the on-chain market.
BTCS offloads Ethereum. BTCS sold $44 million worth of Ethereum to reduce its DeFi debt amid the ongoing market downturn, adding to selling pressure on ETH.
